description: Get the speaker-labelled transcript of a company's earnings call for a fiscal quarter — every speaker turn in order, attributed to the real person (executive or sell-side analyst) with their role at the time. Identities appear only when the resolution is trusted (auto-resolved or human-reviewed); unverified voices show as a role label (e.g. Operator) or a neutral speaker number. While a call is being recorded live, and until its speaker-labelled transcript is ready, the tool returns the preliminary live text instead: numbered machine-transcribed lines without speaker labels, growing every ~20 seconds. Pass after=<the last line number you hold> and run=<the run it reported> to receive only the lines spoken since. Use GetEarningsCallEvent first to check a transcript exists.

after.description: Live text only: the highest line number already received (default -1, the whole text so far); the answer then carries only the lines after it

fiscalQuarter.description: Company fiscal quarter, 1-4. Quarter alone selects the latest matching quarter across fiscal years; provide both fields for an exact period.

fiscalYear.description: Company fiscal year. Omit both period fields for the latest call; year alone selects the latest call in that fiscal year.

limit.description: Maximum number of speaker turns to return (default 50, max 200; values outside 1-200 are clamped)

offset.description: Number of leading speaker turns to skip, for paging through calls longer than the 200-turn cap (default 0)

run.description: Live text only: the run value from the previous live answer; a different run means the recording restarted and the answer carries the full text again

ticker.description: Company ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT), or MIC:TICKER (e.g., XPAR:AIR) for a listing outside the US.

name: GetEarningsCallTranscript
title: Earnings Call Transcript
